basic_details.job_title: Directorate of Public Instruction Special Educator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 38 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications for 38 Special Educator posts under direct recruitment must be submitted in person or by registered post at the offices of the Divisional Joint Director, School Education Division Bastar, Bilaspur, Durg, Raipur and Surguja. The Directorate of Public Instruction (Lok Shikshan Sanchalanalaya) has released a short advertisement. Applications opened on 20 November 2026, and those received after 5 PM on 4 December 2026 will not be considered.

important_instructions: Applications received after the last date will not be considered. Information on invalid applications, the merit list, the selection process and other recruitment matters will be published on the departmental website from time to time. The Directorate will not correspond with candidates on these matters. Candidates are advised to check the departmental website regularly for the latest information.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed format, which is available on the departmental website. They can be handed in personally or sent by registered post. Offices that accept applications: the Divisional Joint Director's office, School Education Division Bastar, Bilaspur, Durg, Raipur and Surguja. Timings: all working days, 10 AM to 5 PM. Applications deposited at any office other than these will not be considered. One application is valid for the vacancies advertised in all districts and divisions. Candidates need not apply separately for each district or division. Postal addresses of the offices and the wording for the envelope are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date will not be considered. Information on invalid applications, the merit list, the selection process and other recruitment matters will be published on the departmental website from time to time. The Directorate will not correspond with candidates on these matters. Candidates are advised to check the departmental website regularly for the latest information.

faq.question: Q1. How many Special Educator posts are there in the Chhattisgarh recruitment?
faq.answer: The Lok Shikshan Sanchalanalaya has announced direct recruitment for 38 Special Educator posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 4 December 2026, up to 5 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. When did applications start?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply from 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Special Educator posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the application in the prescribed format, available on the departmental website. Submit it in person or send it by registered post to one of the named offices.

faq.question: Q5. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications go to the office of the Divisional Joint Director, School Education Division Bastar, Bilaspur, Durg, Raipur or Surguja. They are accepted on working days from 10 AM to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q6. Do I need a separate application for each district or division?
faq.answer: No. One application is valid for the vacancies advertised in all districts and divisions.

faq.question: Q7. Will applications submitted at other offices be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Applications deposited at any office other than the named divisional offices will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the merit list and selection updates appear?
faq.answer: They will be published on the departmental website, https://eduportal.cg.nic.in/, from time to time. The Directorate will not correspond with candidates about them.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the detailed advertisement and the qualification?
faq.answer: The detailed advertisement, with the required educational qualification and other conditions, is on the department website, https://eduportal.cg.nic.in/.
